associations.rationale: The type assigns every linear map an induced map on exterior powers, but it does not state the tensor- and symmetric-power constructions or functoriality under composition.
The equality states preservation of composition by exterior-power maps, but it does not state the three induced-map constructions or composition laws for the other powers.

The equality states preservation of composition by symmetric-power maps, but it does not state the three induced-map constructions or composition laws for the other powers.
